name: Agent evaluators (IntentResolution / TaskAdherence / ToolCallAccuracy)
summary: azure-ai-evaluation agent-quality evaluators with a BYOM-prefixed judge model.
description: The agent-quality evaluators (`IntentResolutionEvaluator`, `TaskAdherenceEvaluator`, `ToolCallAccuracyEvaluator`, `ResponseCompletenessEvaluator`) all take a `model_config` with `azure_deployment`. This card probes whether passing `{conn}/{model}` as the deployment routes through the AI Gateway when the evaluator runs.
notes:
BYOM is blocked by the eval SDK URL-shape bug.

`azure-ai-evaluation` constructs `/openai/deployments/{apim-conn}/{model}/chat/completions`, which Foundry does not route, so the server returns `400 'API version not supported'`.

Expected `XFAIL(strict)`. If Microsoft fixes the SDK URL construction, this should XPASS and flip green in CI.
